title: entry_count() returns tip count, not entry count (wrong semantics)
description: group_log/storage.rs: LogStorage::entry_count() queries log_tips table (count of DAG tips), not total log entries. For a group with 1000-entry history branched into 2 tips, returns 2, not 1000. Method name implies total count. Any caller using this for retention policy, metrics, or size estimates will be wildly wrong. Fix: rename to tip_count() and add a separate total_entry_count() that traverses the DAG, or update the docstring to make the semantic unmistakable.
